title: Online Learning Platform
description: A modern online learning platform designed to facilitate interactive education with video lectures, progress tracking, collaborative tools, and gamification elements. Built with both educators and students in mind.

images.description: Course catalog homepage featuring organized course categories, instructor profiles, and student reviews with easy enrollment process
Video player interface with note-taking capabilities, chapter navigation, playback speed controls, and interactive transcripts
Student progress dashboard showing completion rates, achievement badges, quiz scores, and personalized learning recommendations
Discussion forum and collaboration space with threaded conversations, peer-to-peer learning, and instructor moderation tools
